what: A full Endar Spire run on the unmodded game: every XP event in the order a player meets them. Read by tools/xp/calc.py --scenario.
assumptions: Every hostile creature on the way is killed; all are CR 1, which gives 75 XP at levels 1 and 2 (xptable.2da c1), so their order does not change the total.
Both optional computers are used (maintenance droid in end_m01aa, security computer in end_m01ab) and the damaged droid is repaired with the patrol program.
The PC takes the level-up when end_levelup offers it, so GetHitDice(PC) is 2 in end_m01ab.
Dialog plot XP uses the engine's two ceilings (CSWSDialog::GiveDialogPlotXP 0x0059F3C0: ceil(percent * 100), then GivePlotXP: ceil(plot XP * that * 0.01)), so 10% of 1000 gives 110 and 5% gives 60.
